mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand for residential construction, increasing corporate revenue expectations and reducing equity risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1350k (Jan 2023 value) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 300 indicates persistent inflationary pressure, triggering delayed Fed rate hikes that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL > 300 periods over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST increases and INDPRO decreases indicate demand-strength in housing offset by supply-side manufacturing weakness, causing inventory glut and profit margin compression that reduces S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST > 1350k and INDPRO < 101.0 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 4.5% during active tightening cycles signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing cost of capital and reducing equity multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% periods during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 revisions exceeding 10% of prior estimates indicate stronger-than-expected economic growth, boosting corporate earnings forecasts and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of GDPC1 revision > 10% periods over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS declines exceeding 0.5% signal deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and reducing equity growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of PAYEMS decline > 0.5% periods over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% indicate sustained inflation and restrictive policy, creating prolonged equity market pressure that results in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% periods over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, indicating weakening demand and potential economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO < 100 periods over any 1-year rolling window.
